managedFloor: A managed policy floor is in force
policyStale: The engine's policy is newer than the one shown.

policyVerdict.idempotent: The engine repeated the policy already in force; nothing changed.
policyVerdict.gap: At least one policy update never arrived, so this posture may be out of date.
policyVerdict.conflict: Two policies claim the same revision number, so neither can be trusted.
policyVerdict.version_mismatch: The engine announced a policy format this build of Darhai cannot read.
policyVerdict.not_critical: The engine sent a policy receipt it did not mark as authoritative.
policyVerdict.regression: The engine announced an older policy than the one already in force.
policyVerdict.malformed: The policy receipt could not be read.
